findings.title: Green-run tests do not assert empty output
findings.detail:
AC3 says a green CI run 'still exits 0 with no output'. The green-path tests (lines 53 and 116) check exit 0 and the watch calls but not that r.out is empty. The scripts do end with `>/dev/null && exit 0` before any new line, so it holds by reading; AC3's verifier is agent (hand check).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optionally add expect(r.out).toBe('') to both green-path tests.
